item.title: Don't trust the LLM to do math: a placeholder pattern for production RAG
item.description: For any value the pipeline can compute from authoritative data, the model should emit a slot, not a literal, and the pipeline should fill the slot before the user sees the response.

item.title: Semantic Deduplication for RAG: Reducing Redundancy in Data
item.description: How temporal bucketing plus lightweight lexical filtering makes semantic deduplication tractable, cutting corpus redundancy by up to 80%.
